module_summary: Combinational AXI-stream to LocalLink bridge that inverts handshakes, derives SOF from a registered last-beat flag, and drops single-beat packets.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI input valid; drives LocalLink source-ready, SOF and last_tlast update.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: AXI input ready, inverted copy of LocalLink destination ready.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI input payload passed straight to LocalLink data output.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Packet end marker; produces EOF and updates last_tlast.

anchors.name: ll_data_out
anchors.why: LocalLink output payload driven from s_axis_tdata.

anchors.name: ll_src_rdy_out_n
anchors.why: Active-low LocalLink source ready from tvalid masked by invalid.

anchors.name: ll_dst_rdy_in_n
anchors.why: Active-low LocalLink destination ready, inverted onto s_axis_tready.

anchors.name: ll_sof_out_n
anchors.why: Active-low start-of-frame from last_tlast, tvalid and invalid.

anchors.name: ll_eof_out_n
anchors.why: Active-low end-of-frame from tlast masked by invalid.

anchors.name: last_tlast
anchors.why: Registers previous accepted tlast; marks next beat as start of frame.

anchors.name: invalid
anchors.why: Flags single-beat packets; suppresses SOF, EOF and source ready.

groups.name: AXI input
groups.description: AXI-stream slave side: tdata, tvalid, tready, tlast.

groups.name: Frame tracking
groups.description: Last-beat register and single-beat invalid detection controlling SOF/EOF.

groups.name: LocalLink output
groups.description: Active-low LocalLink data, SOF, EOF, src/dst ready.
